notes.title: Rover Mechanic Simulator - Perseverance DLC out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Rover Mechanics! [/h1]

[h3]The big day has finally arrived! NASA's Perseverance Rover lands on Mars today, and our Perseverance DLC is now officially out on Steam! [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1512110/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator__Perseverance_Rover_DLC/

[b]Perhaps you can’t greet Perseverance on Mars, but you can welcome the new Rover to the workshop in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/]Rover Mechanic Simulator[/url]! Play NOW and tinker with about 200 new unique parts! 30 new missions are waiting for you![/b]

[h3]Full game: [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/

[h3]Gameplay Trailer: [/h3]
[previewyoutube=FJrFM04zpZE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Livestream[/h2]
[u][b]Watch developers' livestream on one of the channels below: [/b][/u]
[list] [*] [b]Steam:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/864680/broadcasts/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/864680/broadcasts/[/url]
[*] [b]YouTube:[/b] [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/ThePyramidLab]https://www.youtube.com/user/ThePyramidLab[/url]
[*] [b]Twitch:[/b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pyramid_games]https://www.twitch.tv/pyramid_games[/url]  [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/0fcd7b784d4ba4571ddfbec56d2f47f5379c439f.png[/img]

Remember also to watch NASA's official broadcast that starts today at 20:15 CET. Perseverance Rover lands on Mars today, on Feb. 18, 2021, at approximately 12:55 p.m. PST! ːsteamhappyː 

[previewyoutube=gm0b_ijaYMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Best Regards,
Rover Mechanic Simulator Team 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/

notes.title: Perseverance Rover is coming to Mars on Feb, 18th!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Rover Mechanics![/h1]

[h3][b]Perseverance Rover[/b] will be landing on Mars on Feb, 18th![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/ef6bb939f400a424b7758274cc9d78547618afd4.png[/img]

On this occasion the shiny new Rover is also [b]coming to Rover Mechanic Simulator in the form of DLC[/b]!

At first glance the new Rover may seem similar to it's older brother Curiosity, but in reality it's very very different. For the last few months we've been working very hard on preparing the Perseverance Rover model [b]completely from scratch[/b] to make it as accurate as possible. 

Prepare to learn more about it and tinker with about 200 new unique parts! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1512110/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator__Perseverance_Rover_DLC/

We are counting down in anticipation for the release and keeping our fingers crossed for the safe landing on Mars! Below you can watch the [b]Official JPL Perseverance Rover landing video[/b]:

[previewyoutube=tITni_HY1Bk;full][/previewyoutube]

Yours Sincerely,
Rover Mechanic Simulator Team
https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/

notes.title: Rover Mechanic Simulator: Full Release is now available!

tags.feature: - Curiosity Jack has been added;
- Curiosity Rover has been added (26 new missions, 311 interactive parts/sets without screws);
- Mars Helicopter Ingenuity has been added (2 missions, 10 interactive parts without screws);
- Uninterruptible disassembly: click'n'hold RMB to unscrew all screws in a set;
- Interaction with Emergency Lever on the wall has been added;
- Possibility to fix the radio and put your own music;
- Part damage visualization has been added;
- Tablet Printer Skill has been added;
- Mini-games have been added: Snake, Speed Writer, Space Invaders, Pong, Meteor Rush;
- Cleaning sound while working on the workbench has been added;
- Uninterruptible soldering on WB: click’n’hold RMB to solder;
- Additional resources for playing mini-games;
- Controls tutorial for Workbench has been added (SHIFT+WSAD);

tags.balance_change: - The process of unscrewing the screws has been accelerated;
- Repeating tasks now gives greater rewards from 50% to 80%;

tags.feature: - Visual Improvements in overhead crane camera;
- The player’s statistics tab in the main menu;
- Visual Improvements in minigame GUI;
- Added many new achievements;
- Added more parts descriptions;
- Tutorial translations updated;
- Save system has been improved;
- Autosave added to the beginning and end of each order;
- Salvaging incomplete sets is possible;
- The scissors lift is placed permanently in the middle of the hangar;
- Support for ultrawide monitors with 21:9 aspect ratio has been added;
- Game Engine updated to newer version;
- Completed quests can be repeated;
- Added help command to gantry computer.

tags.bug: - Problems with "Trained Eye" skill have been solved;
- Bug with blocking workbench has been fixed;
- Bugs with accepting quests have been fixed;
- Problems with saving radio station have been solved;
- Bug with calculating statistics after canceling printing has been fixed;
- Bug with missing material on APXS and Sojourner Camera has been fixed;
- Bug with not loading tutorial save in some circumstances has been fixed;
- Bug with freezing after quick switching between cleaning and repairing on workbench has been fixed;
- Problem with game freeze when you clean panels after completing mission H-8468 has been fixed;
- Bug with swapping parts on PCBs has been fixed;
- Problem with controls reset to default when leaving the game has been fixed;
- Fixed an issue where the "place lift here" text is not disappearing after cancelling the action;
- Bug with resistorE on IC_6 PCB has been fixed;
- Problem with picking up capsules from a 3D printer and then pausing makes the capsules spin around has been fixed;
- Problem with the camera while working on the workbench has been fixed;
- Problem with the airlock sound triggering without airlock moving has been fixed;
- Problem with adding skill points on high screen resolutions has been solved;
- Problem with the weather forecast board showing improper sol has been fixed;
- Problem with triggering the sound without placing a lift has been fixed;
- Problem with seeing the damage on uncleaned parts has been fixed;
- Tablet button animation jittering bug has been fixed;
- Problem with discrepancies in assembly/disassembly has been fixed;
- Bug with a non-refreshing list of tasks after restarting the mission has been fixed;
- Bugs with displaying tutorials in particular languages have been fixed;
- Bugs with incorrect display of the crane's active parts have been fixed;
- Problems with video settings have been fixed;
- Typos have been corrected.

notes.title: Rover Mechanic Simulator: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Rover Mechanics![/h1]

[b][h3]We are excited to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/]Rover Mechanic Simulator[/url] is leaving Early Access next thursday, on 12th of November! [/h3][/b]
Big update with many additional hours of tinkering is coming and it will introduce Curiosity Rover and Mars Helicopter Ingenuity to the game! 🤖 

[previewyoutube=lywJdc8vgP0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]But that’s not all! We will reveal the full list of changes on the launch day![/h3]

[h2]Livestream [/h2]
[b]Next thursday we’ll also be holding a live stream, so make sure to join us on one of the channels below:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/64cf4bf60833ceb429a31958fb045e30e0438ac9.png[/img] [b]Steam:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/864680/broadcasts/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/864680/broadcasts/[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/e652c5257aae85eca18832cdcd9b458b823829b6.png[/img] [b]YouTube:[/b] [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/ThePyramidLab]https://www.youtube.com/user/ThePyramidLab[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/2d4895f5205b61ed278860d1cdb76c2d14707d1d.png[/img] [b]Twitch:[/b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pyramid_games]https://www.twitch.tv/pyramid_games[/url]  

[b]➡️ More info about the live stream will follow soon! It's gonna be fun! 🥳[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/ae8129856b17a555bd68a8cb17650b74881dcc48.png[/img]

[h2]Community Group Challenge![/h2]
Remember that our [b]Community Group Challenge[/b] is still on, make sure to participate! We’re getting close to reaching the 4th goal, which will unlock a new mini-game "Meteor Rush", which is our version of the classic arcade game "Asteroids"! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/b42c83f3579bb7ebd463549457fcf33478eb2a26.png[/img]

[b]Here’s how to join the Steam Community Group:[/b]
Easiest way:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/6e061a847bc85a0c2e5bf0ee0ae11cfedd3ca33c.gif[/img]

[b]The standard way:[/b]
[olist] [*] Enter [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/]Rover Mechanic Simulator store page[/url] and choose “Community Hub” over the logo and game description.
[*]Choose “Follow” on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/864680]RMS Community[/url] main window on top. [/olist]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Bf7tLJu.gif[/img]

[h2]Join our Community![/h2]
[b]If you have questions regarding the game, feel free to ask them on our [url=https://discord.gg/wK9TGPe]Discord Server![/url][/b] We're available to talk almost everyday! 

[url=https://discord.gg/wK9TGPe][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png[/img][/url]

Stay tuned, stay safe and see you on Mars!
Rover Mechanic Simulator Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/

notes.title: Rover Mechanic Simulator Community Group Challenge Goals Reached!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Martians![/h1]

1. We’ve reached 10k people on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/864680]Rover Mechanic Simulator Community Group[/url], which means that you’ll be able to fix the radio in the main game, which unlocks the possibility to put your own music into the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37778807/1a5ae8eb41c9ba350fff136c07dbb681d3e7c305.png[/img]

2. We've also added the [b]Tablet Printer Skill[/b] - so now you can request parts printing directly from your tablet in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/]Rover Mechanic Simulator[/url] (if you unlock this skill): 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/4eb405684236716fd097a8b2542ff4ca99ce9255.png[/img]

3. But that’s not all! We’ve set [b]our second Community Challenge[/b] goal at 10 100 people, so we are also adding [b]Part Damage Visualisation[/b] to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/]Rover Mechanic Simulator[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/dad77320dbbc75bd34d46ce65fe62015f9e6303d.png[/img]


Thank you for your support, you’re amazing! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/dfd2c5da87b5caf0e10f15a768d0b80cf93e55dd.png[/img]

Now it’s time to reach the next goals!  It is up to YOU how far we get :)
[b]The third goal will be the ability to fix Ingenuity - our Mars Helicopter![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/81ae288dbb7b5840ad1b632a68b22ada701e45e6.png[/img]


[b]Here’s how to join the Steam Community Group:[/b]
[olist] [*] Enter [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/]Rover Mechanic Simulator store page[/url] and choose “Community Hub” over the logo and game description.
[*]  Choose “Follow” on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/864680]RMS Community[/url] main window on top. [/olist]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Bf7tLJu.gif[/img]

Remember that our[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/864680/announcements/detail/1819957482663680282] Big Curiosity Rover Update[/url] is also coming very soon! As NASA prepares to launch the next Mars Science Laboratory to Mars, we are preparing to launch the long-awaited Curiosity Update, which will double the current playtime.

Stay tuned, stay safe and see you on Mars! 
Rover Mechanic Simulator Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/6e061a847bc85a0c2e5bf0ee0ae11cfedd3ca33c.gif[/img]
